statement:
act h * act x - act x * act h = (2 : ℤ) • act x ∧
 act h * act y - act y * act h = (-2 : ℤ) • act y ∧
 act x * act y - act y * act x = act h
proof:
constructor
  · have hh := congrArg act h_H005.1.lie_h_e_nsmul
    simpa [act.map_lie, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket] using hh
  constructor
  · have hh := congrArg act h_H005.1.lie_h_f_nsmul
    simpa [act.map_lie, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket] using hh
  · have hh := congrArg act h_H005.1.lie_e_f
    simpa [act.map_lie, LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket] using hh

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type u_2) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_1) [addV : AddCommGroup V]
  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
      Reduction.chevalley x y h →
        Reduction.admissible M (act x) (act y) →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            act h * act x - act x * act h = 2 • act x ∧
              act h * act y - act y * act h = -2 • act y ∧ act x * act y - act y * act x = act h
